subject.title: Telegram: support fail-closed unknown-group handling with optional auto-leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group action config that can warn and leave non-allowlisted groups, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50682 as the starting point?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing config and a security-sensitive Telegram side effect, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Revise the linked Telegram PR
options.body: Use the existing implementation candidate, but require precise unknown-group classification, schema/docs alignment, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep deny-only behavior
options.body: Decline warn/leave config for now and keep current fail-closed drop/log behavior as the supported Telegram posture.

options.title: Fold into broader group security work
options.body: Defer this narrow auto-leave request into the broader group pairing or cross-channel security direction tracked by related issues.

recommendation.title: Revise the linked Telegram PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing implementation candidate, but require precise unknown-group classification, schema/docs alignment, and real Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Telegram authorization and config surfaces most directly trace through recent blame/history involving steipete, and the decision affects that owner boundary.
